title: Total Loss Deductible by Cause, Including the Theft Deductible Add-On
content:
Under the Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision), the deductible the vehicle value paid to a loss payee carries follows the total loss's cause:
- **Theft.** The package's comprehensive deductible plus the theft deductible add-on of 250 USD.
- **Any other comprehensive cause** (weather, animal, fire, vandalism or glass). The package's comprehensive deductible.
- **Collision cause** (collision with another vehicle, or single-vehicle collision). The package's collision deductible.

| Package | Theft (USD) | Other comprehensive (USD) | Collision (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $2,500 Deductible | 2750 | 2500 | 2500 |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $2,000 Deductible | 2250 | 2000 | 2000 |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $1,500 Deductible | 1750 | 1500 | 1500 |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $1,000 Deductible | 1250 | 1000 | 1000 |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $500 Deductible | 750 | 500 | 500 |
| Cardinal Point Physical Damage $250 Comprehensive / $500 Collision Deductible | 500 | 250 | 500 |

The theft column is each package's comprehensive deductible plus the 250 USD add-on.

### Hypothetical case

An unrecovered stolen vehicle on the Cardinal Point Physical Damage $1,000 Deductible package carries 1,250 USD. Had the same vehicle been destroyed by fire, it would carry 1,000 USD.
